patterns: APPSC asks AP urban facts as single-fact items: least urbanised southern State, largest city (Visakhapatnam), number of 1-lakh+ cities (32).
Scheme-city items: HRIDAY town in AP = Amaravati; Smart Cities list; AMRUT Ease of Living 2018 ranking (AP 1st).
City nicknames (City of Destiny, Andhra Paris = Tenali) recur in 2019 and 2025 papers.
Migration patterns and metropolitan regions are barely tested by PYQs; app adds UDAs, economic regions and corridors in depth.
Several app stems lean on 2025-26 survey numbers and odd 'context described' phrasing that no exam uses.
